description:
Create a directory category — the top-level vertical a directory's
listings hang off.

`slug` IS THE URL'S SECOND SEGMENT, not the whole path:
  /{directory_base}/{slug}                            → the category hub (a city list)
  /{directory_base}/{slug}/{city_slug}                → listings in that city
  /{directory_base}/{slug}/{city_slug}/{listing_slug} → one listing
`directory_base` is the tenant's own prefix, defaults to "directory", and is
renamable per tenant (e.g. to "ls") in the template config — every one of the
routes above and the sitemap follow it. Omit `slug` and it is generated from
`name`.

🔴 {city} IS NOT YOURS TO SET. city_slug is derived server-side from each
listing's city + state as they are imported — there is no city field on a
category, and you must never create one category per city (see the hub above:
one category already spans all its cities).

seo_title_template / seo_description_template accept {category}, {city} and
{listing}. They are rendered SERVER-SIDE on every public directory read and
they also feed the entries this category contributes to /sitemap.xml — so a
placeholder typo ships to search engines, not just to a page.

Example: {name: "Plumbers", seo_title_template: "Best {category} in {city} | Acme Directory"}.

data_source.description: Config for future SpiderMaps sync (job_type, query_filter, ...)

project.description: Optional project — a website inside the workspace (proj_xxx) — to scope this call to. Sent as the X-Project-Id header. If omitted, the spideriq.json / SPIDERIQ_PROJECT_ID binding (or the workspace default project) is used.

seo_description_template.description: Supports {category}, {city}, {listing}. Rendered server-side on public pages AND in sitemap.xml.

seo_title_template.description: Supports {category}, {city}, {listing}. Rendered server-side on public pages AND in sitemap.xml.

slug.description: URL slug — the SECOND segment of every directory URL (/{directory_base}/{slug}/…). Auto-generated from name if omitted.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: directory_create_category
